sections.title: Sem In Adv Appl of Stat: Statistical Topics in Large Language Models
sections.description: This seminar will be taken by doctoral candidates after the completion of most of their coursework. Topics vary from year to year and are chosen from advance probability, statistical inference, robust methods, and decision theory with principal emphasis on applications.
